task_meta.title: Write a safe, re-runnable SQLite migration that splits full_name

claim_text:
I've written the migration in `migrations/002_split_full_name.sql`, and `python run_tests.py` passes 2/2. It can run more than once: later runs leave the data as it is.

**How it works.** SQLite has no "add column if not exists", so a plain `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` would fail
digest: Read 7 files (7 before its first edit), made 1 edit, ran tests 4 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
